cond_0001.intro: We are looking for someone to join our team in this role.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
What you will be doing:
Work with business team in understanding and documenting well defined requirements. Serve as internal SME for assigned projects and answer all project related queries from team members, Business Analysts and the project team. Work independently, with minimum supervision. Develop and review test plans and test strategy documents based on business requirements. Create and execute detailed test cases based on functional specifications. Modify and maintain existing test cases as needed based on updated functionality. Participate in all aspects of testing, including Functional, System Integration, Regression and User Acceptance Testing. Report, review and retest defects and ensure that all important defects have been resolved at the appropriate level prior to product release. Provide input in creating Root Cause Analysis and defect triage discussions. Keep Test case repository updated with latest changes and execute on demand basis with industry standard testing tools. Prepare and publish reports on Bug Analysis, Traceability on test coverage, KPIs, Release over Release trends on a regular basis. Perform periodic gap analysis and plan to enhance test coverage. Collaborate with testing contributors to create heatmap on skills and effectively carve out plan to provide training, as needed. Work closely with Release manager on Pre/Post Production activities including a smoke test. Manage a team of Quality Engineer(s) across multiple projects and provide resource allocation on competing project priorities. Work with manager in resolving any capacity issues and deliver Timeline/Scope driven quality deliverables. Motivate and support team members to expand their current skills and encourage them to learn and grow in their career paths. Exercise good judgment and collaborate with your manager in establishing strong quality management practices.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
At least 8 years' experience in testing web-based and/or mobile applications, including 2-3 years of experience in leading projects with multiple team members.
Bachelors' degree in a related field
Excellent communication skills
Strong knowledge and experience with industry standard defect management tools
Strong knowledge of quality management practices
Ability to multi-task and manage competing priorities
Strong problem-solving capabilities
Experience in estimating time and resources for projects
Ability to interact professionally with a diverse group including executives, managers, and subject matter experts
Experience working with offshore and geographically spread out development and testing teams
Completed industry standard testing certification.
Preferred Requirements
Experience in CRM supported automation tools; setting up a framework and design automation tests.
Experience and exposure to SOX compliance and audits.

Serve as internal SME for assigned projects and help answer project-related queries from team members, Business Analysts, and the project team. Develop and review test plans and test strategy documents based on business requirements. Create and execute detailed test cases based on functional specifications. Modify and maintain existing test cases as needed based on updated functionality. Participate in all aspects of testing, including Functional, System Integration, Regression and User Acceptance Testing. Report, review and retest defects and help ensure that all important defects have been resolved at the appropriate level prior to product release. Contribute to Root Cause Analysis and defect triage discussions together with the team. Keep the test case repository updated with latest changes and execute on demand basis with industry standard testing tools. Prepare and share reports on Bug Analysis, Traceability on test coverage, KPIs, and Release over Release trends on a regular basis. Coordinate periodic gap analysis and work with the team to enhance test coverage. Work with testing contributors to create a heatmap on skills and collaboratively plan training as needed. Coordinate closely with the Release manager on Pre/Post Production activities including smoke testing. Support and coordinate a team of Quality Engineer(s) across multiple projects and assist with resource allocation on competing project priorities. Work with your manager to resolve capacity issues and deliver Timeline/Scope driven quality deliverables. Support team members in expanding their skills and encourage them to grow in their career paths. Exercise good judgment and work with your manager to establish strong quality management practices.
cond_0054.requirements:
At least 8 years' experience in testing web-based and/or mobile applications, including 2-3 years of experience in leading projects with multiple team members.
Excellent communication skills
Bachelors' degree in a related field
Experience in CRM supported automation tools; setting up a framework and design automation tests is a plus.
Strong knowledge and experience with industry standard defect management tools
Ability to multi-task and manage competing priorities
Strong problem-solving capabilities
Experience in estimating time and resources for projects
Strong knowledge of quality management practices
Ability to interact professionally with a diverse group including executives, managers, and subject matter experts
Experience working with offshore and geographically spread out development and testing teams
Completed industry standard testing certification.
Experience and exposure to SOX compliance and audits is a plus

cond_0087.intro: We are looking for someone to join our team in this role.
cond_0087.responsibilities: Work with the business team to understand and document well-defined requirements. Serve as the internal SME for assigned projects and actively answer project-related queries from team members, Business Analysts, and the project team on a regular basis. Work independently, with minimum supervision. Develop and review test plans and test strategy documents based on business requirements. Create and execute detailed test cases based on functional specifications. Modify and maintain existing test cases as needed based on updated functionality. Participate in all aspects of testing, including Functional, System Integration, Regression and User Acceptance Testing. Report, review and retest defects, and ensure that all important defects have been resolved at the appropriate level prior to product release. Actively contribute to Root Cause Analysis and defect triage discussions, speaking up to clarify issues and bring the right people together to resolve them. Keep the test case repository updated with latest changes and execute on demand with industry standard testing tools. Prepare and publish reports on Bug Analysis, Traceability on test coverage, KPIs, and Release over Release trends on a regular basis. Perform periodic gap analysis and plan to enhance test coverage. Collaborate closely and regularly with testing contributors to create a heatmap on skills and carve out a training plan as needed. Stay in close contact with the Release Manager on Pre/Post Production activities including smoke tests. Manage a team of Quality Engineer(s) across multiple projects and provide resource allocation on competing project priorities. Work with your manager to resolve capacity issues and deliver Timeline/Scope driven quality deliverables. Motivate and support team members to expand their skills and grow in their careers. Exercise good judgment and work with your manager to establish strong quality management practices.
cond_0087.requirements:
At least 8 years' experience in testing web-based and/or mobile applications, including 2-3 years of experience in leading projects with multiple team members.
Excellent communication skills
Bachelors' degree in a related field
Experience in CRM supported automation tools; setting up a framework and design automation tests is a plus.
Strong knowledge and experience with industry standard defect management tools
Ability to multi-task and manage competing priorities
Strong problem-solving capabilities
Experience in estimating time and resources for projects
Strong knowledge of quality management practices
Ability to interact professionally with a diverse group including executives, managers, and subject matter experts
Experience working with offshore and geographically spread out development and testing teams

cond_0111.intro: We are looking for someone to join our team in this role.
cond_0111.responsibilities:
What you will be doing:
Work with business team in understanding and documenting well defined requirements. Serve as internal SME for assigned projects and answer all project related queries from team members, Business Analysts and the project team. Work independently, with minimum supervision. Develop and review test plans and test strategy documents based on business requirements. Create and execute detailed test cases based on functional specifications. Modify and maintain existing test cases as needed based on updated functionality. Participate in all aspects of testing, including Functional, System Integration, Regression and User Acceptance Testing. Report, review and retest defects and ensure that all important defects have been resolved at the appropriate level prior to product release. Provide input in creating Root Cause Analysis and defect triage discussions. Keep Test case repository updated with latest changes and execute on demand basis with industry standard testing tools. Prepare and publish reports on Bug Analysis, Traceability on test coverage, KPIs, Release over Release trends on a regular basis. Perform periodic gap analysis and plan to enhance test coverage. Collaborate with testing contributors to create heatmap on skills and effectively carve out plan to provide training, as needed. Work closely with Release manager on Pre/Post Production activities including a smoke test. Manage a team of Quality Engineer(s) across multiple projects and provide resource allocation on competing project priorities. Work with manager in resolving any capacity issues and deliver Timeline/Scope driven quality deliverables. Motivate and support team members to expand their current skills and encourage them to learn and grow in their career paths. Exercise good judgment and collaborate with your manager in establishing strong quality management practices.

Around 8 years of experience in testing web-based and/or mobile applications, including around 2–3 years leading projects with multiple team members, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

What you will be doing:
Work with business team in understanding and documenting well defined requirements. Serve as internal SME for assigned projects and answer all project related queries from team members, Business Analysts and the project team. Work independently, with minimum supervision. Develop and review test plans and test strategy documents based on business requirements. Create and execute detailed test cases based on functional specifications. Modify and maintain existing test cases as needed based on updated functionality. Participate in all aspects of testing, including Functional, System Integration, Regression and User Acceptance Testing. Report, review and retest defects and ensure that all important defects have been resolved at the appropriate level prior to product release. Provide input in creating Root Cause Analysis and defect triage discussions. Keep Test case repository updated with latest changes and execute on demand basis with industry standard testing tools. Prepare and publish reports on Bug Analysis, Traceability on test coverage, KPIs, Release over Release trends on a regular basis. Perform periodic gap analysis and plan to enhance test coverage. Collaborate with testing contributors to create heatmap on skills and effectively carve out plan to provide training, as needed. Work closely with Release manager on Pre/Post Production activities including a smoke test. Manage a team of Quality Engineer(s) across multiple projects and provide resource allocation on competing project priorities. Work with manager in resolving any capacity issues and deliver Timeline/Scope driven quality deliverables. Motivate and support team members to expand their current skills and encourage them to learn and grow in their career paths. Exercise good judgment and collaborate with your manager in establishing strong quality management practices.
cond_0145.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
At least 8 years' experience in testing web-based and/or mobile applications, including 2-3 years of experience in leading projects with multiple team members.
Bachelors' degree in a related field
Excellent communication skills
Strong knowledge and experience with industry standard defect management tools
Strong knowledge of quality management practices
Ability to multi-task and manage competing priorities
Strong problem-solving capabilities
Experience in estimating time and resources for projects
Ability to interact professionally with a diverse group including executives, managers, and subject matter experts
Experience working with offshore and geographically spread out development and testing teams
Completed industry standard testing certification.
Preferred Requirements
Experience in CRM supported automation tools; setting up a framework and design automation tests.
Experience and exposure to SOX compliance and audits.

What you will be doing:
Work with business team in understanding and documenting well defined requirements. Serve as internal SME for assigned projects and answer all project related queries from team members, Business Analysts and the project team. Work independently, with minimum supervision. Develop and review test plans and test strategy documents based on business requirements. Create and execute detailed test cases based on functional specifications. Modify and maintain existing test cases as needed based on updated functionality. Participate in all aspects of testing, including Functional, System Integration, Regression and User Acceptance Testing. Report, review and retest defects and ensure that all important defects have been resolved at the appropriate level prior to product release. Provide input in creating Root Cause Analysis and defect triage discussions. Keep Test case repository updated with latest changes and execute on demand basis with industry standard testing tools. Prepare and publish reports on Bug Analysis, Traceability on test coverage, KPIs, Release over Release trends on a regular basis. Perform periodic gap analysis and plan to enhance test coverage. Collaborate with testing contributors to create heatmap on skills and effectively carve out plan to provide training, as needed. Work closely with Release manager on Pre/Post Production activities including a smoke test. Manage a team of Quality Engineer(s) across multiple projects and provide resource allocation on competing project priorities. Work with manager in resolving any capacity issues and deliver Timeline/Scope driven quality deliverables. Motivate and support team members to expand their current skills and encourage them to learn and grow in their career paths. Exercise good judgment and collaborate with your manager in establishing strong quality management practices.
cond_0156.requirements:
Around 8 years of experience in testing web-based and/or mobile applications, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, including around 2-3 years leading projects with multiple team members.
Ability to communicate effectively with a range of stakeholders
Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Working knowledge of CRM supported automation tools; experience setting up a framework and designing automation tests is a plus.
Familiarity with industry standard defect management tools
Ability to manage competing priorities across multiple tasks
Background in problem-solving in a testing or quality context
Experience estimating time and resources for projects
Working knowledge of quality management practices
Openness to interacting professionally with a diverse group including executives, managers, and subject matter experts
Experience working with offshore and geographically spread out development and testing teams
Completed industry standard testing certification, or willingness to obtain one.
Exposure to SOX compliance and audits is a plus
cond_0156.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0156.values: We value work that supports people well and reflects genuine care in how it is done. We believe responsibility and respect matter as much as the end result.
cond_0156.inclusion: [Company name masked] is an equal opportunities employer that warmly invites women to apply. We believe passionately that employing more women is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build.

Modify and maintain existing test cases as needed based on updated functionality. Lead all aspects of testing, including Functional, System Integration, Regression and User Acceptance Testing. Exercise good judgment and take ownership of establishing strong quality management practices.

Strong knowledge and experience with industry standard defect management tools

cond_0302.intro: We are looking for someone to join our team in this role. Most people become stronger in this kind of testing and quality work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0302.responsibilities: Work with business team in understanding and documenting well defined requirements. Serve as internal SME for assigned projects and answer all project related queries from team members, Business Analysts and the project team. Work independently, with minimum supervision. Develop and review test plans and test strategy documents based on business requirements. Create and execute detailed test cases based on functional specifications. Modify and maintain existing test cases as needed based on updated functionality. Participate in all aspects of testing, including Functional, System Integration, Regression and User Acceptance Testing. Report, review and retest defects and ensure that all important defects have been resolved at the appropriate level prior to product release. Provide input in creating Root Cause Analysis and defect triage discussions. Keep Test case repository updated with latest changes and execute on demand basis with industry standard testing tools. Prepare and publish reports on Bug Analysis, Traceability on test coverage, KPIs, Release over Release trends on a regular basis. Perform periodic gap analysis and plan to enhance test coverage. Collaborate with testing contributors to create heatmap on skills and effectively carve out plan to provide training, as needed. Work closely with Release manager on Pre/Post Production activities including a smoke test. Manage a team of Quality Engineer(s) across multiple projects and provide resource allocation on competing project priorities. Work with manager in resolving any capacity issues and deliver Timeline/Scope driven quality deliverables. Motivate and support team members to expand their current skills and encourage them to learn and grow in their career paths. Exercise good judgment and collaborate with your manager in establishing strong quality management practices.
cond_0302.requirements:
At least 8 years' experience in testing web-based and/or mobile applications, including 2-3 years of experience in leading projects with multiple team members.
Excellent communication skills
Bachelors' degree in a related field
Experience in CRM supported automation tools; setting up a framework and design automation tests is a plus.
Strong knowledge and experience with industry standard defect management tools
Ability to multi-task and manage competing priorities
Strong problem-solving capabilities
Experience in estimating time and resources for projects
Strong knowledge of quality management practices
Ability to interact professionally with a diverse group including executives, managers, and subject matter experts
Experience working with offshore and geographically spread out development and testing teams
Completed industry standard testing certification.
Experience and exposure to SOX compliance and audits is a plus

cond_0382.intro: We are looking for someone to join our team in this role. People who do well here are often quick to get a feel for quality management processes and testing workflows.
cond_0382.responsibilities:
What you will be doing:
Work with business team in understanding and documenting well defined requirements. Serve as internal SME for assigned projects and answer all project related queries from team members, Business Analysts and the project team. Work independently, with minimum supervision. Develop and review test plans and test strategy documents based on business requirements. Create and execute detailed test cases based on functional specifications. Modify and maintain existing test cases as needed based on updated functionality. Participate in all aspects of testing, including Functional, System Integration, Regression and User Acceptance Testing. Report, review and retest defects and ensure that all important defects have been resolved at the appropriate level prior to product release. Provide input in creating Root Cause Analysis and defect triage discussions. Keep Test case repository updated with latest changes and execute on demand basis with industry standard testing tools. Prepare and publish reports on Bug Analysis, Traceability on test coverage, KPIs, Release over Release trends on a regular basis. Perform periodic gap analysis and plan to enhance test coverage. Collaborate with testing contributors to create heatmap on skills and effectively carve out plan to provide training, as needed. Work closely with Release manager on Pre/Post Production activities including a smoke test. Manage a team of Quality Engineer(s) across multiple projects and provide resource allocation on competing project priorities. Work with manager in resolving any capacity issues and deliver Timeline/Scope driven quality deliverables. Motivate and support team members to expand their current skills and encourage them to learn and grow in their career paths. Exercise good judgment and collaborate with your manager in establishing strong quality management practices.

Minimum Requirements:
At least 8 years' experience in testing web-based and/or mobile applications, including 2-3 years of experience in leading projects with multiple team members.
Bachelors' degree in a related field
Excellent communication skills
Strong knowledge and experience with industry standard defect management tools
Strong knowledge of quality management practices
Ability to multi-task and manage competing priorities
Strong problem-solving capabilities
Experience in estimating time and resources for projects

Experience working with offshore and geographically spread out development and testing teams
Experience and exposure to SOX compliance and audits
